meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. Probative benchmarks, 2025–2026 are approximate bands, tiers and rounded values from Probative's own data, kept for marketing planning. They are not a forecast for any one firm.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.

summary: Probative benchmarks, 2025–2026: aggregated, rounded, and small groups suppressed. Our data on law-firm marketing, shown as bands, named tiers and rounded values, one table per file. The public tables cover how quickly inquiries become signed clients, phone calls and signed clients, AI answers and organic search clicks, search-ad click costs, what people type, calls from ads, Local Services Ads leads, inquiries by quarter and ad cost per signed client. Each row gives the measure, the band or tier, its unit and a rough size band. Every value is aggregated across many observations; values resting on too few observations, or resting mostly on a few, are suppressed for privacy. Values are approximate, so read the band, not a point. The methods page defines every measure and the protection steps.
